json.evidence: Across all photos, the round meter sits in a small, compact gray socket (roughly just the enclosure around the meter) mounted separately to the left of a tall gray breaker panel/load center. The meter-holding enclosure is much smaller than the adjacent panel and is not a large rectangular or 320A-style can.
json.notes: The tall adjacent breaker panel, BASE battery/transfer equipment, and disconnects are separate enclosures and were ignored. The images are distant security-camera views, but the size of the meter socket relative to the brick courses and the adjacent panel is clear enough to judge it as a standard compact residential socket.
